scope: Noether Paper 38 GDZ/JRAM167 600ppi source repair for Brauer-Hasse-Noether, Beweis eines Hauptsatzes in der Theorie der Algebren, integrated after the P36 repair line.

files.scope: P38 source-repair package with cumulative German candidate, GDZ/JRAM167 600ppi witnesses for printed pp.399-404, native crops, confirmed-fix ledger, diff, and provenance.

observed_contents: Restores source title/author block and drafting footnote assigning the note to H. Hasse.
Repairs source-style Hauptsatz statement formatting and punctuation.
Restores Reduktion 2 wording and notation, including Sigma for the Sylowkorper, A_Sigma, and the divisor/index sentence.
Restores footnote 4 and the Zusatz wahrend der Drucklegung block from source p400.
Corrects the Reduktion 3 Lambda chain to source K=Lambda_0>Lambda_1>...>Lambda_r=Omega and restores related proof indexing.
Restores the source Normensatz paragraph on p401, including the Hilbert-Furtwangler special case, the displayed Normenrestsymbol, and A=(alpha,Z).
Includes full-resolution source witnesses for printed pp.399-404, native 600ppi crops for patched loci, source-quality ledger, confirmed-fixes CSV, and compile logs.
caveats: Best-available source repair only; GDZ/JRAM167 witness is 600ppi, below the local 650ppi strict floor.
pp.402-404 are included as full-resolution witnesses but were not globally certified line-by-line in this package.
Later Folgerungen sections may still contain modernization/compression, especially around Satz 3-6 notation and set-inclusion wording.
Not full Paper 38 symbol/formula/layout certification, not a critical edition, and not whole-Noether closure.
next_action: Retain for Noether source-audit/provenance staging; upload only with below-650ppi and partial-line-certification caveats and do not present as Paper 38 closure.
